note_en: Look at 哪怕……也……: 哪怕只是散步半个小时，也能让心情变好 "even if it's just a half-hour walk, it can lift your mood." English needs only "even if," but Chinese pairs 哪怕 in the first clause with 也 in the second, and the 也 can't be dropped. The text also uses 不再……而是…… "no longer A but B" (不再被当作“软弱”的表现，而是被看作……), another two-part frame where English needs just one connecting word.
